correctedClaims.v0Claim: A caller-selected SessionId, once its header agrees, may be presented as the Attempt's session (BOUND_LOCAL_ONLY) and its events may populate the Attempt's execution view.
correctedClaims.correction: A caller's SessionId is a CLAIM (SESSION_CLAIMED_UNVERIFIED). It never establishes a binding, its events are never admitted to the Attempt (sessionReadAdmission = NOT_ADMITTED_TO_ATTEMPT), and an unattributed read cannot make the Handoff COMPLETE.

correctedClaims.v0Claim: A supplied HostRecord's fields may be merged into an Attempt's Preview without checking that the record names that Attempt.
correctedClaims.correction: hostRecord.attemptId must equal the requested attemptId before any field is accepted; a mismatch raises HOST_RECORD_CONFLICT rather than being silently dropped.

correctedClaims.v0Claim: The Preview may be constructed for any attemptId; the absence of canonical Work facts is reported as a null record.
correctedClaims.correction: The attempt must be admitted against the canonical Work history BEFORE any execution source is read: exactly one ATTEMPT_CREATED with entity_id === attemptId and project_id === projectId, plus a canonical Work record that does not contradict it. Refusals are typed: ATTEMPT_NOT_FOUND, FOREIGN_ATTEMPT, ATTEMPT_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

correctedClaims.v0Claim: Work nodes belonging to the requested Attempt can be located by node.label.includes(attemptId), and a permitted relation name is sufficient to present a relation as selected.
correctedClaims.correction: Selection uses the exact canonical Work event_id identity set, requires ESTABLISHED_BY_OWNER_REFERENCE, requires a non-null TrajectoryEdgeEvidence whose carrying reference is one of those canonical events in this project. Anything else is quarantined or unresolved.

correctedClaims.v0Claim: Every event returned by the cold DSH read is a persisted event of the session.
correctedClaims.correction: readColdSessionLog appends interruptedTurnClosers, so returned events are classified PERSISTED_DSH_EVENT or SYNTHETIC_RECOVERY_EVENT by comparing against the stored prefix read through the persistence handle seam; when the seam is unavailable the boundary is DURABILITY_UNRESOLVED.

correctedClaims.v0Claim: The reader may coerce an unusable cursor to a default and read the whole log before returning a bounded slice, without disclosing the distinction.
correctedClaims.correction: A negative, fractional or excessive cursor is refused (INVALID_REQUEST). A hard maximum page size applies. RETURN_PAGE_BOUNDED is reported separately from DISK_IO_PAGE_BOUNDED, and the reader discloses that it reads the whole validated log before slicing.

noNewAuthority: Trajectory remains a read-only consumer: no store, no scheduler, no settlement, no promotion, no admission, no resumption, no injection.
